name: Philadelphia Garage
description: Philadelphia Garage coats and finishes floors so the space works for cars, tools, and the overflow from the house. Call for a look at your slab.

hero.headline: A garage you can park on and live with
hero.sub: Philadelphia Garage coats and finishes floors so the space works for cars, tools, and the overflow from the house. Call for a look at your slab.

story.heading: The floor is the room
paragraphs: A pretty coat on a dirty slab fails. We talk about prep, moisture, and what you park on it before we talk color.
You will know how long the car lives in the driveway. We keep that timeline honest.
Philadelphia Garage serves people who live and work in Chester County.
You'll find the phone and the next step on this page, not buried in a menu.
Come in when you're ready. We'll make the visit straightforward.
Neighbors already know the name. The site should make the first visit easy.
Bring questions. Leave with a plan you can follow.
Chester County floorer care, written so a person can act on it.

feature.heading: Prep you can trust
feature.text: Most failures start with skipped grind work. We will not skip it to win a cheaper bid.

spotlight.heading: We come to the garage
spotlight.text: Street address is confirmed on the official site when the listing is complete. Call and we will meet you at the house.

contact.heading: Show us the slab
contact.sub: Call with photos and the town. We will tell you if the floor is ready.
